### Setup

```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(rprojroot)
library(glue)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-immune-deconvolution")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))
```

### Load files

```{r}
# Read metadata and keep unique Bioassay_IDs
metadata <- read_tsv(file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-rna-expression", "input", "Haydar_Mouse_RNA_miRNA_manifest_IDs_assigned.tsv")) %>%
  distinct(Bioassay_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Define cell types to keep
keep_mouse <- c("Microglia", "macrophage", "monocyte",
                "natural killer cell", "T cell", "astrocyte")

keep_immgen <- c("CD4-positive, alpha-beta T cell", "macrophage", "monocyte",
                 "CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell", "T cell",
                 "natural killer cell", "Gamma-delta T cell")

# Read, reshape, merge, and filter
xcell2_long <- read_tsv(file.path(results_dir, "xCell2_all_references_merged.tsv")) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("BA_"), names_to = "Bioassay_ID", values_to = "EnrichmentScore") %>%
  select(Bioassay_ID, CellType, Reference, EnrichmentScore) %>%
  left_join(metadata %>% select(Bioassay_ID, Treatment, Day), by = "Bioassay_ID") %>%
  rename(Time = Day) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = recode(Treatment,
                       "B7H3 CAR" = "CAR",
                       "B7H3 STOP CAR" = "Ctrl CAR"),
    Time = recode(as.character(Time),
                  "21" = "Day21",
                  "14" = "Day14"),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("Day14", "Day21")),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("CAR", "Ctrl CAR", "Untreated"))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    (Reference == "MouseRNAseqData" & CellType %in% keep_mouse) |
    (Reference == "ImmGenData" & CellType %in% keep_immgen)
  )
``` 

### Plot xCell2 Enrichment Score

```{r plot-by-treatment, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define treatment contrasts (for stat_compare_means)
treatment_contrasts <- list(c("CAR", "Ctrl CAR"), c("CAR", "Untreated"))

# Function to plot each time point
plot_xcell2_by_time <- function(df, time_point) {
  df %>%
    filter(Time == time_point) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = EnrichmentScore)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = Treatment),
                shape = 21, width = 0.2, size = 2.5,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.05, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_compare_means(
      method = "wilcox",
      comparisons = treatment_contrasts,
      method.args = list(alternative = "two.sided"),
      label = "p.signif",
      step.increase = 0.15
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL,
         y = "xCell2 Enrichment Score",
         title = glue("xCell2 Immune Enrichment — {time_point}")) +
    facet_grid(Reference ~ CellType,
               scales = "free_y",
               labeller = labeller(CellType = label_wrap_gen(18))) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.25))) +
    theme_Publication() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

# Generate and save plots for each time point
p_day14 <- plot_xcell2_by_time(xcell2_long, "Day14")
p_day21 <- plot_xcell2_by_time(xcell2_long, "Day21")

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "xcell2_EnrichmentScore_byTreatment_Day14.pdf"),
       plot = p_day14, width = 14, height = 6)

ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "xcell2_EnrichmentScore_byTreatment_Day21.pdf"),
       plot = p_day21, width = 14, height = 6)
```

```{r plot-by-reference, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define pairwise comparisons between treatments
treatment_contrasts <- list(c("CAR", "Ctrl CAR"), c("CAR", "Untreated"))

# Function to plot one reference and time point
plot_xcell2 <- function(df, ref_name, time_point) {
  df %>%
    filter(Reference == ref_name, Time == time_point) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Treatment, y = EnrichmentScore)) +
    geom_jitter(aes(fill = Treatment),
                shape = 21, width = 0.2, size = 2.5,
                alpha = 0.85, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.05, outlier.shape = NA) +
    stat_compare_means(
      method = "wilcox",
      comparisons = treatment_contrasts,
      method.args = list(alternative = "two.sided"),
      label = "p.signif",
      step.increase = 0.15
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "xCell2 Enrichment Score",
      title = glue("{ref_name} — {time_point}")
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~CellType, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y",
               labeller = labeller(CellType = label_wrap_gen(18))) +
    theme_Publication() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
}

# Generate unique combinations of references and time points
plot_combos <- expand_grid(
  Reference = unique(xcell2_long$Reference),
  Time = unique(xcell2_long$Time)
)

# Loop through each combo and save
for (i in seq_len(nrow(plot_combos))) {
  ref <- plot_combos$Reference[i]
  time <- plot_combos$Time[i]
  
  p <- plot_xcell2(xcell2_long, ref, time)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plot_dir, glue("xcell2_EnrichmentScore_{ref}_{time}.pdf")),
    plot = p, width = 12, height = 6
  )
}
```
